annotations.title: List what a verified business sells

description: Return the machine-readable catalogue a verified business publishes. Under owner_provided: who and where the business is, then each item with its name, description, integer price in cents, currency and unit, as the business typed them. Prices are exactly what the business published. An item with price_on_request: true has no price (it reads "Price on request"): the business quotes each job, so ask it with request_quote rather than estimate a number.
name: list_business_offerings
title: List what a verified business sells
